title: 完整人工智能超级课程 2026
summary: 一个覆盖 AI 全栈学习路径的开源课程仓库，从 Python、数学、机器学习、深度学习，到 Transformer、LLM、提示工程、RAG、Agent、MCP、多模态、评估安全与 MLOps，最终以企业级 AI 项目收尾。
summary_en: An open-source curriculum repo covering the full AI learning path, from Python, math, ML, and deep learning to Transformers, LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG, agents, MCP, multimodal AI, evaluation, security, and MLOps, ending with an enterprise AI capstone.
